focus_areas: Fur texture realism and strand definition
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the micro-texture of the fur. AI often fails to render individual hair strands consistently in high-density areas like the cheeks and forehead. Check if the 'shagginess' looks like clumped noise or distinct fibers. Also, verify the moisture/reflection on the lips and the object in the mouth for physical plausibility.
